behavior_changes: AdapterDiscoveryRequest gains trailing optional mode / as_of_date / fiscal_period / form_type; fiscal_year becomes optional and is only mandatory in exact mode
mode=latest_as_of queries one seDate window of (as_of.year-2)-01-01..as_of instead of a guessed fiscal-year window
latest candidates are filtered by UTC filing_date <= as_of_date, sec_code, title-derived year, kind and explicit period/form_type hints; the caller's fiscal_year hint never narrows latest
latest pagination follows raw totalRecordNum/totalpages and raises non-retryable discovery_incomplete when the 5-page cap cannot prove coverage
latest raises non-retryable bounded_discovery_empty when a fully covered window yields no valid candidate
duplicate announcement ids with conflicting payloads now fail instead of silently overwriting
exact pagination also advances on raw totals so a filtered-empty first page no longer stops discovery early
CLI validates the whole request before constructing StockDownloader (no provider/browser/network for a malformed request)
AdapterError carries typed code/retryable and the CLI prefers them over message parsing
CLI accepts an optional provider-local org_id that skips StockDownloader.mapping
